g.title: j4243350861
g.text: I like getting to bundle up by a warm fire. It's so peaceful and cozy.

g.title: j2008414129
g.text: The snow is just so pretty when it's fresh. And it's fun to play in.

g.title: j826211177
g.text: I like to pick at peeling sunburns.

g.title: j3956399465
g.text: Bright warm sun, time on the beach... ocean waves.

g.title: j2623028074
g.text: Water blaster fights! Dog days are always a laugh.

g.title: j3028543490
g.text: Watching things die makes me happy.

g.title: j3627239224
g.text: We had these dormizone trees whose leaves used to change colors in the fall. It was so beautiful.

g.title: j2726677442
g.text: When Amir made us those "apple cider donuts" I think I got *hooked.*

g.title: j3135764983
g.text: This is going to sound weird, but I think bees are adorable. I like watching them do their thing.

g.title: j2693838483
g.text: Spring flowers. They're so beautiful, even if they don't last long.

g.title: j3755130029
g.text: that sounds like something out of a postcard

g.text: yeeeesssssss aaaghhh i miss going to the beeeaaach

g.text: OML u still have epicdrenchers in the future?!?! AMAZING

g.text: ooooh like in new ludston!! i got 2 visit there a few times. sooo pretty

g.text: I try not to think too hard about how he got the apples...

g.text: thats what makes them so beautiful. if we had them all year long we'd just ignore them

g.text: cherry blossoms are only special bcuz they're only here 4 such a short time, u know?

g.text: i think the trick to being happy in life is learning to see the beauty thats here all the time
